analysis_name: E3 (Cross-Encoder) vs E4 (LambdaMART) Ranking Error Analysis

root_cause_findings.issue: Dead Feature: skill_overlap_ratio & skill_coverage_weighted were all zeros (0.0)
root_cause_findings.mechanism: Job parsing extracted skills from prose description via regex rather than using the ground-truth required_skills attribute on GoldenJob. This zeroed out features 1 and 2 across all 12,000 candidate-job pairs in the training and evaluation matrices, depriving LambdaMART of explicit skill overlap information.

root_cause_findings.issue: Cross-Encoder Score Double-Sigmoid and Asymmetric Input Mismatch
root_cause_findings.mechanism: FeatureExtractor applied normalize_cross_encoder_score (sigmoid) to scores that CrossEncoderReranker had already sigmoid-transformed. Furthermore, feature extraction paired (job_text, cand_text) whereas E3 inference paired (cand_text, job_text). This compressed the effective dynamic range of feature 6 (cross_encoder_score) to [0.528, 0.584] during training.

root_cause_findings.issue: Sample Selection Bias (Coarse Full-Catalog Training vs. Fine-Grained Top-20 Inference)
root_cause_findings.mechanism: LambdaMART was trained on 200 items per candidate where 85-90% were coarse negatives (different job families). It learned heavy split weights on title_similarity and semantic_similarity to reject coarse negatives. At inference time in E4, Hybrid RRF had already filtered down to the top-20 items where title_similarity variance is tiny noise, leading LambdaMART to demote Grade-3 jobs with slightly different titles in favor of Grade-2 jobs with identical titles.
